# Dynatrace to Acquire Arize: Full-Lifecycle AI Observability

Published: August 13, 2026 | Author: Steve Tack | Read Time: 8 minutes

## Key Announcement
Dynatrace has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Arize, combining AI-native
evaluation tools with enterprise observability capabilities to address a critical gap in
production AI monitoring.

## Core Problem Addressed
AI systems fail differently than traditional software. While conventional applications
produce traceable errors, AI applications can appear functional while being inaccurate,
biased, or misaligned. Research revealed that 51% of agentic AI leaders cite technical
challenges managing agents at scale as a top barrier to production deployment.

## What Arize Brings
- Phoenix: Open-source AI observability platform for tracing applications, running
  evaluations, and investigating failures during development
- Arize AX: Managed enterprise platform providing agent observability, online evaluations,
  and production monitoring
- OpenInference: Open specification for AI tracing built on OpenTelemetry

## Expected Combined Capabilities
- Compare model performance between development and production environments
- Investigate AI degradation across the full technology stack
- Connect quality metrics with operational signals like latency and costs
- Link agent workflows directly to business outcomes
- Feed production insights back into improvement cycles

## Commitment to Open Standards
Dynatrace intends to support Phoenix independently and continue stewardship of
OpenInference, maintaining vendor-neutral access for developers.

## Status
Integration pending regulatory approval; existing products and relationships remain
unchanged immediately following close.
